# Orb Documentation
# For AI Agents and LLMs
# https://orb.thomas.md (formerly https://sandboxed.sh)

> Orb is a unified client (macOS Tauri + SolidJS, iOS SwiftUI, Web) for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (`agy`), OpenCode, and Grok) and cloud agents (Hermes, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Cursor Cloud).
> Note: `sandboxed.sh` is the former name of the project and is now the Rust backend (`sandboxed-sh`) to the Orb clients.

## How to Access Documentation as Raw Markdown

All pages are available as raw markdown:
1. **Automatic**: Known LLM User-Agents (`ChatGPT-User`, `GPTBot`, `Claude-Web`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Applebot`, `cohere-ai`, `anthropic-ai`, `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`) automatically receive `text/markdown`.
2. **Add `.md` extension**: e.g. `/getting-started.md`, `/workspaces.md`, `/api.md`
3. **Accept header**: `Accept: text/markdown`
4. **Query param**: `?format=md`
5. **Direct API**: `/api/docs/_index` (JSON list) or `/api/docs/_all` (all docs concatenated)

## Documentation Index

### Getting Started
- `/index.md`: Overview of Orb + sandboxed.sh, the three execution modes, and architecture
- `/getting-started.md`: Connecting Orb on macOS and iOS, scanning local agents, and configuring CLIProxyAPI subscriptions
- `/setup.md`: Native Ubuntu 24.04 and Docker server deployment
- `/install-docker.md`: Docker Compose quick start and `systemd-nspawn` container setup
- `/first-mission.md`: Live mission steering, `/plan`, `/goal`, `/btw` side agents, wake-ups, and machine transfer

### Architecture & Concepts
- `/workspaces.md`: Execution placements (`placement: "client"`, `core`, `remote_node_id`), host vs `systemd-nspawn` containers, `missions.slice` cgroups, DGX Spark build offload, and cross-machine mission transfer
- `/library.md`: Shared project `@context`, synchronized project skills (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`), and the Git-backed global Library

### Reference
- `/api.md`: REST API, cursor-paginated events, SSE streaming, and unified MCP (`sandboxed-mcp` / `/api/mcp`)
- `/desktop.md`: Headless Wayland/Sway (and Xvfb fallback) browser & GUI automation

## Quick Architecture Reference

### Three Execution Modes
1. **Your computer (`placement: "client"`)**: Orb Desktop spawns local CLIs (`claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `opencode`, `grok`) on macOS in `~/.orb/local-runs/<mission-id>` while syncing transcripts and `@context` to Core.
2. **Your private cloud (`core` or `remote_node_id`)**: Core or leased `sandboxed-node` machines run harnesses inside per-mission host directories or `systemd-nspawn` containers under `missions.slice` cgroups.
3. **Cloud agents**: Core adapters connect to durable **Hermes** coordinator sessions, **ChatGPT** web profiles, **Grok Bot**, or **Cursor Cloud**.

### Key API Endpoints
```http
POST /api/control/missions                      # Create local, Core, node, or cloud mission
GET  /api/control/missions/:id/snapshot         # First-paint mission snapshot
GET  /api/control/missions/:id/events           # Cursor-paginated event history (X-Orb-Events-Protocol: 1)
GET  /api/control/stream?mission=<id>           # Real-time SSE stream
POST /api/control/message                       # Send or queue follow-up message
POST /api/control/missions/:id/btw/agent        # Launch/continue /btw side agent
POST /api/control/missions/:id/machine-transfer # Move mission between local, Core, and fleet nodes
GET  /api/projects/overview                     # Project roster and attention items
GET  /api/projects/:slug/situation              # Bounded project state read
GET  /api/remote-nodes                          # Fleet nodes and remote_launch capabilities
POST /api/mcp/call                              # Unified MCP tool invocation (executor/coordinator/operator)
```
